mechanism: Both agents have sympathomimetic and stimulant properties that may potentiate CNS and cardiovascular effects, with ginseng potentially inhibiting CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 metabolism of methylphenidate.
action: Monitor for increased stimulant effects (tachycardia, hypertension, insomnia, anxiety); consider dose adjustment of methylphenidate or discontinuation of ginseng if adverse effects occur.
